title: Vidyom node catalog, version 1
description: The contract between workflows and node implementations. Every node type a workflow may use is listed with its owner component, pool (I7), side-effect class (D11), parameter schema and output schema. Parameters are camelCase and outputs snake_case, as the spec's §6 examples show. Parameter schemas apply after ${...} references are resolved; the engine's static validation checks only required keys and types of literal values.

uri.description: An input URI: server:, upload:, storage://<role>/<key>, import:<connector>/<id> (R20), or scratch:// for files between nodes (I5).

assetRef.description: A friendly ID or ULID, resolved in the job's tenant.

storedObject.description: Output of writing to a role; has the shape of domain.MediaFile plus uri.

artifact.description: A file on the job's scratch volume.

assetOutput.description: The asset, plus URIs usable as node parameters.

nodes.title: Branch on a CEL condition (D2, D33).
Join branches (D33).
Wait without holding a process.
Run a subworkflow per item; each item is its own child job, with concurrency and item limits.

items.description: An array, or a ${...} reference to one.

itemInput.description: Child input that receives the item. Default item.

nodes.title: Invoke a subworkflow with input and output isolation. Every parameter other than workflow and version is a child input; the output is the child's outputs (§6.4).
Human gate; the job waits without any CLI connected (R25, D7).

evidence.description: Shown to the reviewer: excerpt, timestamps, confidence, alternatives (D51).

nodes.title: Write an event to the outbox.
Allocate an ID and create an asset (registered). Emits asset.created and clip.created.
Resolve an asset. requireClipEligible applies domain.Asset.ClipEligible (I21).
List assets for maintenance workflows.
Edit metadata; never creates a media version (D35).
Move the asset state machine (§2.5).
Set asset flags; master_available=false stops create-clip (§2.5).
Record a stored file on a version. Refuses an immutable version (D35).
Write the permanent provenance summary (R21). The engine fills job and workflow fields.
Return the version to write: the current one, or a new one when it is immutable (D35).
Check the consolidated readiness condition (R11) and set ready_for_clipping. Emits asset.ready_for_clipping.
Warn about clips overlapping these segments, without blocking (D47).
For clips of clips: map segments to the root original's timeline and pick its master when the edit is continuous (D36).
Build the per-asset metadata package (§12.5). Sensitive segments are redacted (D30).
List rejected or never-approved renders past their retention (D16).
Release an input's spool copy once archive and master are verified (R9). A server: path is never deleted.
Soft-delete after publications are withdrawn; keeps the audited fact and reports the early-deletion estimate (D17, R16).
Read an asset version's stored transcript and analysis, for reindexing (D15).
List archive copies of soft-deleted assets past their minimum storage duration (D17).
Write a file to a role and verify its checksum.
Read an object to scratch through the verified cache. Refuses archive unless allowArchive and the job holds storage.archive.restore.
Verify an object's checksum.
Delete an object. Missing is success.
Copy between roles. Reading archive needs allowArchive and storage.archive.restore; only restore-archived does it.
Inspect a file with ffprobe, including VFR and broken-timestamp detection (D21).

ext.description: Original file extension without the dot, for original.<ext> (R26).

nodes.title: Transcode to a profile, or auto:master to pick by source height (D14, I25). Never upscales. Normalizes VFR to CFR in the master (D21).
Compare durations to the reference; fails above max(100 ms, 1 frame) (R10, D21).
Render a preview of the segments from the proxy (§3.2).
Render a clip master. The source must be the master role or a verified cached copy of it; archive is refused with no fallback (§6.4).
Extract a thumbnail.
Extract ASR audio from the working master, never from the proxy or archive (D56). Never upscales (D40).
Transcribe local audio through the AI worker (D9). Refuses external engines on local_only assets (D8).
Chunk a transcript per D15 and embed it (D9).
Summary, chapters, tags and stories through an allowed LLM endpoint (D8, D9). available=false when none is allowed (I28). Sensitive segments never go to external AI (D30).
Store the transcript and analysis and index text and vectors in the canonical catalog (D5). Emits asset.indexed and original.indexed.
Hybrid retrieval restricted to the asset, then complete-story boundaries (§3.2, §4.4). Works with no LLM, marking the result ambiguous (I28). segments is the top candidate.

asset.description: Output of catalog.get, or an asset reference.

nodes.title: Derive a clip's transcript from its source by mapping segments to the clip's timeline (§4.3).
Draft title, description and tags (§3.2 step 12); falls back to the prompt and source title with no LLM (I28).
Write open formats to scratch: JSON, SRT, VTT, Markdown (§4.1). excludeSensitive drops marked segments for anything public (D30).
Create the publication record and pick the file: the master when identical (R4). Enforces approval timing (D37). Emits publication.created.
Resumable upload from the master role, with the idempotency key. Reconciles with the destination before any retry (D11).
Poll until the destination finishes; rejected_by_destination is distinct from failed (D52).
Set visibility, thumbnail and captions, write published only with a URL from the destination (R43), mark the version immutable (D35), emit publication.completed.

captions.description: Rendered by this node from the stored transcript with sensitive segments removed, only for an approved public video (D30, I228). No file is accepted.

approvalId.description: The approval that authorizes a visibility other than private, when the record has none or a change needs a new one (D7, D37).

scheduledAt.description: RFC 3339. Publishes at this time on destinations that support scheduling (D52).

nodes.title: Withdraw from destinations; repeating is a no-op (§15.8). Emits publication.withdrawn.
Re-read remote state into the record. Emits publication.updated on change.
Rebuild this tenant's public.db from approved public records and ship it (D18). Withdrawals disappear on rebuild (R44).
Optional MediaCMS connector (D24), a skeleton in this version (I11). Sets catalog_sync; use continueOnFailure so it never blocks readiness (R11).
